text: RELIANCE.NS (Reliance Industries): Diversified conglomerate across O2C, Jio telecom, and Retail; moderate beta with strong domestic cashflows.
TCS.NS (Tata Consultancy Services): Defensive Tier-1 Indian IT exporter with strong operating margins, low debt, and USD revenue sensitivity.
HDFCBANK.NS (HDFC Bank): Leading private-sector bank in India; sensitive to RBI repo rate cycles and credit-deposit ratio norms.
INFY.NS (Infosys): Large-cap IT services firm with AI/cloud transformation pipeline; higher earnings-day volatility than TCS.
ITC.NS (ITC Ltd): Low-volatility defensive FMCG and consumer conglomerate with steady dividend yield; acts as a portfolio stabilizer during market shocks.
Default user risk profile: Max drawdown limit is 15%, single-stock cap is 35%, minimum cash reserve is 10%, risk aversion lambda is 1.5.
